drafted_from: tool:list-my-automations's own row (its words, input schema, sample run) and what its sample run answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show everything my account does by itself on the signed-in page: each trigger, schedule and kept-running program with what sets it off in plain words, what it does, whether it is on, its last run and a switch, each workflow with the words of the conditions it fires on, and one of them opened as a when-then graph with the input of what it runs", with {"wakes":[{"tool":"tool:sample","id":"on-invoice","on":{"fact":{"kind":"message","from":["sender"],"match":{"topic":"invoice"}}},"budget":{"steps":1},"switched_on":true,"mark":{}}]}. It runs tool:list-my-automations and answers {"automations":[{"id":"tool:sample/on-invoice","open_id":"automation:tool:sample/on-invoice","kind":"trigger","name":"Sample: On invoice","when":"When a message is recorded whose topic is 'invoice'","does":"Sample","starts":null,"enabled":true,"state":"on","red":false,"last_run_at":null,"last_problem":null,"switch":{"tool":"tool:sample","id":"on-invoice","on":true,"turn":"off","label":"Turn off"}}],"workflows":[],"red":0,"on":1,"off":0}.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the wake:list rows (and, if you give them, your workflow rows and tool descriptors) and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show everything my account does by itself on the signed-in page: each trigger, schedule and kept-running program with what sets it off in plain words, what it does, whether it is on, its last run and a switch, each workflow with the words of the conditions it fires on, and one of them opened as a when-then graph with the input of what it runs", and give it wakes (the rows wake:list answers), and optionally recipes (your workflow rows) and tools (descriptors of the tools your wakes run).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-my-automations and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give wakes (the rows wake:list answers), optionally recipes (my workflow rows; fields kept as JSON text are read back), tools (descriptors of the tools the wakes run: id, label, input_schema) and open (an id the list gave). Returns automations (id, open_id, kind trigger|schedule|running, name, when, does, starts, enabled, state, red, last_run_at, last_problem, switch), workflows (workflow_id, label, job, steps, fires_when words, enabled) and counts of red, on and off; with open, that one automation or workflow: says, does, then, input_schema, last_run and graph {steps, edges}. Reads only; the switch is the engine's wake:switch.

4. To open one, call it again with the same input and open set to an id from the list. To turn one off or on, the engine's wake:switch takes the row's switch ({tool, id, on}); this tool never changes anything.
